title: Off-the-Shelf Autonomous Agents for Game Playtesting
abstract: arXiv:2611.31570v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In playtesting games, a human operator is typically required to test most gameplay elements. In this work we present Buddy, an autonomous game solving agent which can solve long time horizon objectives in an unseen 3D role-playing game using off-the-shelf language model systems. Buddy will take actions, receive feedback on those actions, and pursue a goal across many turns. No written walkthrough or model training of any kind is required, and we show that this paradigm holds in a novel environment where the agent must discover solutions via exploration rather than recalling them from pretraining. We demonstrate three downstream capabilities: game solving with no provided walkthrough, logging bug tickets for encountered difficulties, and conversion of successful agent traces into scripted hierarchical task networks for regression testing. Unlike existing playtesting solutions, our framework is fully modular: language models and harnesses

translated_title: 基于现成模型的自主智能体用于游戏测试
translated_abstract: 在游戏测试中，通常需要人工操作员来测试大部分游戏玩法元素。在本工作中，我们提出了Buddy，一个自主游戏求解智能体，它能够使用现成的语言模型系统在一个未见过的3D角色扮演游戏中解决长时程目标。Buddy会执行动作、接收这些动作的反馈，并在多个回合中持续追求目标。整个过程无需任何书面攻略或任何形式的模型训练，我们证明这一范式在全新环境中同样成立——智能体必须通过探索来发现解决方案，而非从预训练中回忆答案。我们展示了三种下游能力：在没有攻略的情况下完成游戏、为遇到的困难记录缺陷工单，以及将成功的智能体轨迹转换为脚本化的分层任务网络以用于回归测试。与现有的游戏测试方案不同，我们的框架是完全模块化的：语言模型和运行框架可以灵活组合。
tldr: 提出Buddy——一个完全基于现成语言模型、无需训练或攻略的自主智能体，能在未见过的3D角色扮演游戏中通过探索解决长时程目标，并支持自动记录缺陷工单和将成功轨迹转化为分层任务网络用于回归测试。
en_tdlr: Buddy, an autonomous playtesting agent built entirely from off-the-shelf language models, solves long-horizon objectives in unseen 3D RPGs through exploration without any training or walkthroughs, while also enabling bug ticket logging and conversion of successful traces into hierarchical task networks for regression testing.
